ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rectangle $ABCD$, $AB=4$ and $AD=10$. When the vertex $P$ of the right angle of a right-angled ruler slides along side $AD$ (point $P$ does not coincide with $A$ or $D$), one of the right-angle sides passes through point $C$ and the other right-angle side intersects $AB$ at point $E$. $Rt\triangle AEP \sim Rt\triangle DPC$; when $\angle CPD=30^\circ$, what is the length of $AE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} In right triangle $\triangle PCD$, $\angle CPD=30^\circ$ and $CD=4$, \\
therefore $PC=8$, \\
therefore $PD=\sqrt{PC^{2}-CD^{2}}=4\sqrt{3}$, \\
therefore $AP=AD-PD=10-4\sqrt{3}$, \\
As right triangles $\triangle AEP \sim \triangle DPC$ indicate: $\frac{PD}{AE}=\frac{CD}{AP}$, thus $\frac{4\sqrt{3}}{AE}=\frac{4}{10-4\sqrt{3}}$, \\
therefore $AE=\boxed{10\sqrt{3}-12}$.

When the vertex $P$ of the right angle of a right-angled ruler slides along side $AD$ (point $P$ does not coincide with $A$ or $D$), one of the right-angle sides passes through point $C$ and the other right-angle side intersects $AB$ at point $E$. $Rt\triangle AEP \sim Rt\triangle DPC$; when $\angle CPD=30^\circ$, what is the length of $AE$?
ready3_open_rewrite.raw_answer: \textbf{Solution:} In right triangle $\triangle PCD$, $\angle CPD=30^\circ$ and $CD=4$, therefore $PC=8$, therefore $PD=\sqrt{PC^{2}-CD^{2}}=4\sqrt{3}$, therefore $AP=AD-PD=10-4\sqrt{3}$. As right triangles $\triangle AEP \sim \triangle DPC$ indicate: $\frac{PD}{AE}=\frac{CD}{AP}$, thus $\frac{4\sqrt{3}}{AE}=\frac{4}{10-4\sqrt{3}}$, therefore $AE=\boxed{10\sqrt{3}-12}$.

Reasoning: By the coordinate method, let B=(0,0), C=(10,0), D=(10,4), A=(0,4). Because ∠CPD=30°, in right triangle PDC, CD=4 is the side opposite the 30° angle, so PD=4√3. Therefore P is on AD, with coordinates P=(10-4√3,4). The slope of line PC is (0-4)/(10-(10-4√3))=-4/(4√3)=-1/√3. Since PE ⟂ PC, the slope of PE is √3. Let E=(0,y), then the slope of PE is (4-y)/(10-4√3)=√3, solving gives 4-y=√3(10-4√3)=10√3-12. Therefore AE=4-y=10√3-12.
